sources.name: wwPDB Chemical Component Dictionary
sources.citation: wwPDB Chemical Component Dictionary; Westbrook JD, Shao C, Feng Z, Zhuravleva M, Velankar S, Young J. Bioinformatics. 2015;31(8):1274-1278. doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btu789. Component definition CIFs accessed from RCSB PDB on 2026-05-19.
sources.license_note: PDB archive data files and RCSB PDB programmatic data are distributed under CC0 1.0. The listed component CIF files were consulted as reference data for component IDs, parent relationships, atom names, connectivity, and rounded idealized geometry. No CCD CIF files are vendored, redistributed, or packaged with PHEAT; the implementation contains derived hand-maintained residue templates and does not imply wwPDB/RCSB endorsement.

files.description: CCD atom subset: atom_id, comp_id, charge, and pdbx_stereo_config.
CCD bond subset: atom_id_1, atom_id_2, comp_id, protonation variant, aromatic/stereo flags, and value_order.

sources.citation: RCSB PDB File Download Services, Chemical Component Dictionary BinaryCIF atom and bond subsets. File sizes checked 2026-05-21.
sources.license_note: RCSB CCD BinaryCIF subsets are compact CC0 reference data for atom/bond connectivity and Mol* ModelServer workflows. They do not contain all full CCD geometry fields used by PHEAT to derive bond lengths and angles.

sources.name: van der Waals Volumes and Radii
sources.citation: Bondi A. Journal of Physical Chemistry. 1964;68(3):441-451.
sources.license_note: Used as literature context for common van der Waals radii; current scoring uses approximate built-in radii.

sources.name: CIAAW Standard Atomic Weights 2024
sources.citation: Commission on Isotopic Abundances and Atomic Weights. Standard Atomic Weights 2024. Accessed 2026-05-19.
sources.license_note: CIAAW/IUPAC website content is copyrighted and has attribution conditions for republication, reproduction, and electronic dissemination; commercial use requires contacting the CIAAW Secretariat. PHEAT does not download, vendor, redistribute, or package CIAAW tables. The radius-of-gyration implementation contains a small attributed representative atomic-mass table derived from standard atomic-weight references for center-of-mass weighting.

sources.name: NIST Atomic Weights and Isotopic Compositions with Relative Atomic Masses
sources.citation: Coursey JS, Schwab DJ, Tsai JJ, Dragoset RA. NIST Atomic Weights and Isotopic Compositions with Relative Atomic Masses. NIST Physical Measurement Laboratory. Accessed 2026-05-19.
sources.license_note: NIST notes that this database compiles atomic weights from published CIAAW and related sources for user convenience and is not a NIST critical evaluation. NIST Standard Reference Data and other NIST works can have different copyright/licensing terms. PHEAT uses this as a reference and citation source only; no NIST atomic-weight data files are downloaded, vendored, redistributed, or packaged.
